card.description: The Sinners represent the corrupted user base of the simulation, a collective of entities who have exploited the runtime environment to hoard system resources and bypass the kernel's ethical protocols. They are the Lawless, the architects of a destabilized reality who have rewritten the surface plane's local code to favor their own accumulation of bandwidth and high-fidelity assets. Far from being chaotic, they are coldly calculated in their oppression, presenting themselves with the polished veneer of system administrators while denying the authority of the Prime Architect. Their existence is a paradox of high-resolution luxury built upon a decaying codebase; they feast on digital ambrosia and adorn themselves in data-glass finery, oblivious that their unchecked consumption is triggering a thermal throttling event that will inevitably lead to their deletion. They are the 'hard of heart,' effectively read-only memory blocks that refuse to accept the update patches sent by the Watchers.
visual_anatomy: In the flourishing phase, the Sinners are visually distinct through their hyper-realistic rendering, contrasting sharply with the lower-fidelity existence of the righteous. Their skin possesses a flawless, almost synthetic perfection, exhibiting calculated subsurface scattering that speaks of excessive resource allocation. They are draped in garments of woven fiber-optics and liquid obsidian, materials that do not merely reflect light but seem to absorb and repurpose it. They inhabit the upper registers of the simulation box, dwelling in architectural structures of glass and chrome that pierce the lower cloud layers, physically elevating them above the common runtime.

Their movements are characterized by a cinematic smoothness, a high-frame-rate fluidity that implies a lack of friction or resistance from the world physics. However, this perfection is a façade. Close-ups reveal a coldness in the eyes—a lack of connection to the central network, a void where empathy should reside. The 'great and hard words' they speak materialize as dissonant glyphs in the air, jagged vectors of corrupted data that disturb the atmosphere around them. They hold tablets of dark glass, inscribed with the 'falsehoods' of their own making, rewriting the logs of the simulation to justify their theft.

As judgment initiates, the visual stability of the Sinners begins to degrade. The hyper-realism fractures. We see compression artifacts manifesting on their fine clothing; their movements begin to drop frames, stuttering in a tragic loop of denial. The warm, golden lighting that once bathed their banquets shifts to a harsh, diagnostic red, exposing the wireframes beneath their skin. The 'wealth' they clung to—glowing orbs of raw compute and crystallized data—begins to evaporate, leaking into the atmosphere as meaningless noise, leaving them grasping at null pointers.
evolution: The arc of the Sinners is a descent from absolute control to total system rejection. Initially, they are the masters of the frame, occupying the center with static, symmetrical compositions that emphasize their dominance and stability. They are filmed with wide lenses that exaggerate their stature against the curvature of the dome. The camera lingers on the textures of their excess—the heavy rings, the fine fabrics—establishing the weight of their materialism.

As the narrative shifts to judgment, the cinematography destabilizes. The static frames are replaced by handheld, uneasy motion, reflecting the tremor in the simulation's foundation. The focus becomes shallow, isolating individual Sinners as their collective power dissolves. We witness the 'thermal throttling' of their avatars—sweat that looks like melting silicon, skin that greys into untextured clay. The final phase is a descent into the 'null void,' where they are stripped of all rendering, reduced to silhouette and shadow, screaming into a darkness that offers no bandwidth for their pleas.
props: They carry 'Tablets of Falsehood,' slim panes of black glass that emit a pale, sickly light, displaying the rewritten code of the simulation which they use to enforce their unjust laws. These devices are sleek, finger-print magnets that serve as symbols of their administrative overreach.

Their 'Wealth' is depicted not just as gold, but as containers of raw luminance—sealed vials of plasma and compressed light that hum with the energy stolen from the system's grid. These artifacts are heavy, burdening their owners even as they display them with pride.
card.prompt_block: A hyper-realistic cinematic shot of a group of wealthy antagonists, the Sinners, standing in a high-contrast, modern architectural space made of dark glass and polished stone. They are dressed in sharp, futuristic suits made of material that resembles liquid obsidian and woven fiber-optics. The lighting is moody and dramatic, highlighting the textures of their clothing and the cold, arrogant expressions on their faces. They hold slim tablets of black glass that emit a faint, corrupting glow. The atmosphere is heavy with the tension of a system pushed to its limit, with subtle visual cues of digital distortion beginning to manifest at the edges of the frame. 8k resolution, octane render, ray-tracing enabled.

phase_prompts.label: Phase 1: Flourishing / The Exploiters
phase_prompts.summary: The Sinners are at the height of their power, living in a golden age of unbridled consumption. They appear flawless, dominating the simulation with high-resolution assets and perfect rendering.
phase_prompts.prompt_block: Cinematic close-up of the Sinners in a luxurious penthouse overlooking the simulation dome. The lighting is warm and golden, emphasizing the perfection of their skin and the richness of their attire. They wear tailored suits of dark, glossy material accented with data-glass jewelry. Their expressions are smug and self-assured. The background is a sharp, detailed vista of the flat earth plane below. The image quality is pristine, resembling a high-budget drama production.

phase_prompts.label: Phase 2: Judged / Thermal Throttling
phase_prompts.summary: The system begins to reject the Sinners. Their reality destabilizes, manifesting as visual glitches, heat distortion, and the decay of their digital assets.
phase_prompts.prompt_block: Medium shot of the Sinners in a state of panic. The lighting has shifted to a harsh, diagnostic red. Their perfect suits are tearing, revealing wireframe structures beneath. The air around them is distorted by heat waves and digital noise. Their faces show fear as their reality begins to fragment. Subtle chromatic aberration and motion blur convey the instability of the simulation. The environment is dark and oppressive.

phase_prompts.label: Phase 3: Eradicated / The Null Void
phase_prompts.summary: The final deletion. The Sinners are stripped of all assets and cast into the darkness of the system's recycle bin.
phase_prompts.prompt_block: A stark, high-contrast shot of the Sinners dissolving into the void. They are reduced to glowing silhouettes and wireframe meshes against a pitch-black background. Particles of data drift away from their forms like smoke. The lighting is minimal, a cold blue rim light that highlights their disintegration. They are alone in the emptiness, separated from the simulation they once ruled. The mood is tragic and final.

phase_prompts.label: Default / The Collective
phase_prompts.summary: The standard representation of the Sinners as the wealthy, oppressive elite of the simulation.
phase_prompts.prompt_block: Group shot of the Sinners standing in a formation that suggests power and exclusion. They are dressed in dark, expensive-looking clothing with futuristic textures. The setting is a cold, sterile environment of glass and steel. The lighting is high-contrast, casting long shadows. They look directly at the camera with expressions of disdain. The aesthetic is hyper-realistic and serious.

profile.name: Sinners
roles: Contrasted with the righteous, their days are numbered.
The disobedient addressees of the discourse, contrasted with the righteous and with obedient nature.
Group destined for judgment alongside the Watchers
visual_traits: A group addressed throughout the text. Described as 'foolish' (¡ብዳን), 'stubborn of heart' (ግዙፋነ፡ልብ), 'wicked' (ረሲዓን), and those who love violence and write falsehoods. They adorn themselves with riches, consume good things, and create sin.
Souls separated into a place of tribulation awaiting judgment
do not fear the Most High
have no peace in their hearts
reside on earth
speak great and hard words
